folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B138, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
[SAVES](SAVES.md) owns persistence policy and its later compatibility ledger. E1-E10 remain useful engineering considerations; they do not restore a universal old-save migration guarantee or require every listed historical fixture before unrelated work. The October 17/18 decisions permit a stated reset/drop or content-id retirement, while new state still needs its scoped Save/reload/Export/Import proof. A guarded final write or one Web Lock does not establish rollback across every live owner, archive or enrolled authority key.

Preserve E4's semantic history contract: disposable display logs differ from evidence consumed by inheritance, obligations and powers. E5/E7 catch-up needs declared clocks, remaining elapsed time and causal ordering; aggregation follows actual equivalent outcomes and AD52's meaningful intervention. The 4 MiB guard is shared-origin UTF-16 accounting, not a browser capacity promise. Relevant source was checked; no new storage-failure or catch-up run occurred.

T/P/O options and all linked platform claims remain dated research. The existing desktop/browser delivery and desktop-first priority do not require a Tauri spike, Rust/TypeScript/ECS rewrite, worker, IndexedDB move or mobile qualification. Measure a selected workload before choosing its fix, including bridge and serialization cost. Portability ideas L1-L17 remain useful when a host is selected: complete assets, explicit transfer, independent host storage, cancellation, process death, suspend policy, writer ownership and deliberate conflicts. Packaging alone is not gameplay proof, and this pass installed or launched nothing.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B138, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
F1-F6 and D1-D5 were reviewed in full. Preserve the distinction between the old fresh public opening compilation, source-only Notebook/progressed-panel findings and unrun A1-A5 gates. The 390 px observation is historical; laptop clipping and large-text reachability remain legitimate desktop questions. Mobile optimization and the full 390/768/1440/1920 matrix are not new universal gates under the current desktop-first direction.

The useful design is a single layout owner moving eligible views, with stable focus, selection, scroll, recovery and one authoritative command path. A moved or duplicated view must not create an extra timer, reward, clock advance or location permission. Observer-safe picker/search/counts and recoverable hidden controls apply before rendering, not merely to tooltips. Preference storage/export scope should be stated rather than silently equated with gameplay persistence.

The old original-default and universal docking proposal yields to [DESIGN](../DESIGN.md) and [UI rules](UI_RULES.md): functional task composition, useful independent panes and prose-first presentation. This is no new layout specification or framework migration. Current rules may already cover a finding without proving its particular runtime consumer fixed. Reopen with one rebuilt selected desktop route and its actual missing behavior; no capture, progressed route or persistence result was newly verified here (AD32, AD36, AD42).

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B138, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The whole persistence owner and historical engineering review were read. The summary now distinguishes active release keys from lives carried inside an envelope, unsupported-version/schema rejection from a supported but lossy downgrade, and the wired pack slice from its earlier unwired proposal. Prior wording is retained in the B138 amendment ledger.

Current source inspection confirms `save data`/`dev save data`, `importSaveFile` validation/preflight before guarded publication, the shared-origin UTF-16 budget including other keys, and the registered `world_packs` save/load hooks. The searched `src` JavaScript contains no external `revealWorldPackPerson` or `world_packs` reveal caller; that remains a named gameplay-uptake gap, not an absent save writer. This is bounded source evidence, not a new runtime, loader, full-suite or browser proof.

Preserve the distinction between a slice's deliberate compatibility choice and new product authority. G1's actual loader coverage, G3's exact-field rejection, G4's schema-2 test weakness and G5/G6 completeness remain open at their documented scope. A test-hook reveal/one-pack crossing receipt cannot close all world fact, edge, exception, pack revision or real-action persistence. The early engineering targets are proposals, with mobile and host migration still deferred unless selected; personal saves stay untouched (AD32, AD36, AR6).

**One storage key per life, one JSON envelope.** The browser holds the live envelope as a
single `localStorage` string; Export wraps the same JSON as base64 with a marker prefix.
post_record_amendments.to:
**One active save key per release channel, one JSON envelope.** The live and dev channels use
`save data` and `dev save data`; continuation may carry several lives within that envelope,
with separate archive/authority keys described below. The browser stores the active envelope
as one `localStorage` string; Export wraps the JSON as base64 with a marker prefix.
